Name: Movie Theatre Tweaks
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod moves the ticket use dialogue to the actual theatre doors inside the building, allowing you to enter the lobby, play the crane game, and buy concessions without a movie ticket.

This mod also lets you remove the man hogging the crane game completely, set custom open and close hours for the theatre, and watch as many movies per week as you like.

There is another mod that should let you buy concessions as items:

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15892]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15892[/url]


[size=5][b]Config[/b]
[/size]
You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

﻿﻿If you want to complain or ask for help or help me test my mods, you can visit [url=https://discord.gg/bs6zHuj]my Discord server﻿[/url].
